As the longtime sponsor of the annual ICAST New Product Showcase, Fishing Tackle Retailer is proud to present the 2026 category winners, along with the industry’s most coveted honor—the Best of Show award. The 2026 New Product Showcase featured several notable changes, including a reduction in categories from 41 in 2025 to 37 this year. Longstanding categories such as freshwater and saltwater rods, reels, hard baits, and soft baits remained unchanged. However, the Fly Rod and Reel Combo category was consolidated into the broader Rod and Reel Combo category. Likewise, the former Fly Fishing Waders and Wading Boots category was eliminated, with waders moving into Fly Fishing Technical Apparel and wading boots shifting to the Footwear category. The previous Fly Tying Vises, Tools, and Materials category was also streamlined into Fly Tying Tools and Materials. New for 2026 was the First Time Exhibitor Product category, which gave companies making their ICAST debut the opportunity to showcase a product while also allowing that same item to be entered into its applicable product category. As always, ICAST delivered an impressive lineup of innovative products, fresh ideas, and breakthrough technologies that are sure to influence the fishing industry for years to come. What follows is a complete rundown of the 37 category winners, as selected by attendees at this year’s ICAST in Orlando, Florida, along with the 2026 Best of Show winner. 2026 Best of Show and Rod & Reel Combo Rhino 30 6’6” 2pc Medium Spinning Combo Rhino combos pair an ultra-durable rod and an exceptionally engineered reel that’s ready for battle. Asyx Drive™ gears increase tooth contact for maximum torque. Five ball bearings, instant anti-reverse, oversized bail wire deliver smooth power. HydroShield™ seals protect gears, drag, and handle from water and debris. TriAx Core™ blank provides 360° strength and balanced power with a solid tip. ArmorOne™ PVD one-piece guides resist failure. RhinoGrip™ EVA handle with custom seat for control. Cutlery, Hand Pliers or Tools BUBBA Pro Series Gen 2 Electric Fillet Knife YOU spoke. WE listened. Built from years of extensive angler & power-user feedback, the BUBBA Pro Series Gen 2 Electric Fillet Knife redefines fish processing. A 20% slimmer handle, proprietary paddle trigger, next-generation brushless motor, & species-specific blade technology deliver unmatched comfort, control, power, & efficiency. The result: cleaner fillets, maximum yield, reduced hand fatigue, & the ultimate standard for speed, precision, and performance at the fillet table. Saltwater Hard Lure Shimano LEDGERUNNER – LR200SA The Ledge Runner 200SA sets a new standard in offshore diving plugs, built for power, stability, and depth control. Its ADR system lets anglers adjust trolling depth instantly without retying, and HCW stabilization keeps ittracking at high speeds. A reinforced body adds long‑term durability. Designed for versatile spreads, it delivers depth adaptability, high‑speed stability, and rugged performance. Novelties and Wellness
